reason: A offers the more relevant and discriminating extension: deposition-controlled grain refinement linked to nucleation barriers in the first-order magnetostructural transition, with direct structural and cycling tests against an as-deposited baseline. B largely transfers an annealing/exchange-disorder explanation already demonstrated in a different, second-order FCC HEA, gives non-decisive predictions, and assumes defect removal will reduce hysteresis even though defects can facilitate transformation nucleation.
